Manager.Title: Renown Groups
Manager.Hint: Create factions, organizations and communities, their ranks and members.
Manager.Intro: Groups track renown (DMG 2024). Membership lists are calculated from actors.
Manager.Empty: No groups yet. Create the first one.
Manager.DeleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its renown entries will be removed from every actor.
Manager.RanksHint: The DMG 2024 defines no default ranks: set your own thresholds. A rank is reached at its minimum score; other prerequisites are just text.
Manager.DropHint: Tip: you can also drag actors from the sidebar onto this tab. Characters and the party get a score; NPCs become members of the group.
Manager.NoMembers: Nobody is linked to this group yet.
Manager.NoRanks: No ranks yet. Add one or start from the DMG thresholds.

Picker.Title: Add actors
Picker.Empty: Every eligible actor is already linked to this group.
Picker.Hint: Characters and the party get a score; NPCs become members.

Npc.NoStanding: Outside the automation: no groups and no individual relations.
Npc.Lock: Lock disposition (stop automation for this NPC)
Npc.NoFactions: Not a member of any group.

Benefits.DMG3: Recognition: a respected member; other members are Friendly by default and offer lodging and food in dire need. Possible perks: a reliable contact, a safe house or a discount on adventuring gear.
Benefits.DMG10: Possible perks: access to Potions and Scrolls, calling in a favor, or backup on dangerous missions.
Benefits.DMG50: Possible perks: calling on a small army, acquiring a Rare magic item, the help of a spellcaster, or assigning missions to lower-ranked members.

Notify.NoGM: A GM must be connected to change renown.
Notify.Error: Tidy Renown: the change could not be saved. See the console for details.
Notify.InvalidActor: Only characters, parties and NPCs can be linked to a group.
Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM can manage renown groups.
Notify.TidyMissing: Tidy Renown requires Tidy 5e Sheets to be active. The module is disabled.

PlayersCanIncrease.Name: Players can increase renown
PlayersCanIncrease.Hint: Owners see a +1 button on their own entries. Each request is validated and applied by the GM. Players can never lower scores or create relations.

AutoDisposition.Name: Automatic token disposition
AutoDisposition.Hint: Module extension (not in the DMG): NPC tokens become Hostile or Friendly based on the party's score with their groups or with them directly.

HostileThreshold.Name: Hostile threshold
HostileThreshold.Hint: NPC tokens become Hostile when the party score is below this value.

FriendlyThreshold.Name: Friendly threshold
FriendlyThreshold.Hint: NPC tokens become Friendly when the party score is above this value.

ShowNpcRelations.Name: Show NPC relations to players
ShowNpcRelations.Hint: Players can see the Renown tab on NPC sheets they are allowed to open.

Notes.Title: Notes: {actor} · {target}
Notes.Label: GM notes
Notes.Hint: Players who own the actor can read these notes. Use a Secret block for text only the GM sees.
